d:
Sama-chakeva bhaee-pavan ke atut prem aur tyag ka parv hai, jo pauranik katha par aadharit hai. iska bhagvan krishn se bhi sanbandh hai. bihar ke mithilanchal, kosi aur simanchal ke sath-sath jharkhand aur nepal ke ilakon men yah tyohar manaya jata hai. yah parv is bar 16 navanbar yani chhath parv ke paran ke din shuru huee hai aur 22 navanbar yani kartik purnima par iska samapan hoga.
